image.subject: a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar, neat side-parted hair, sallow cautious face, 1815 Marseille ship's accountant turned Paris banker, standing at a brass shop telegraph in a Paris bond office, 1830s

storyboard.claim: The Count squeezes Danglars with a telegraph trick.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Danglars at the telegraph desk in a Paris bond office, pale and tense.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Opens the Danglars ruin after the Count's bond-market threat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The telegraph is the weapon of the squeeze.

image.subject: a hilltop optical telegraph tower in the French countryside, two wooden semaphore arms raised against a grey sky, 1820s

storyboard.claim: France had an optical telegraph before electric wires.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A wooden semaphore tower on a bare hilltop under grey sky.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the technology behind the squeeze.
storyboard.addedInformation: Towers with moving arms, not wires.

image.subject: two uniformed telegraph operators inside a cramped stone tower cabin, one peering through a brass telescope while the other pulls the lever that swings the wooden arms, 1820s France

storyboard.claim: Operators move arms into shapes to pass messages along a chain of towers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two operators in a tower cabin, one at a telescope, one at the lever.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes how the optical network works.
storyboard.addedInformation: Each tower relays the shape it sees.

storyboard.claim: The operators never knew what the messages meant.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Three short lines of text naming what the operators did.
storyboard.onScreenText: COPY THE SHAPES / NO CODE KEY / NO IDEA WHAT IT SAYS
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the relay can be bribed unnoticed.
storyboard.addedInformation: Operators were blind copiers.

image.subject: a long dusty French road running between a line of tall wooden telegraph towers across green hills, 1820s, early morning

storyboard.claim: The optical telegraph was the era's internet backbone.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A road lined with towers stretching over hills.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Frames the telegraph as cutting-edge tech.
storyboard.addedInformation: Towers in a line form a national network.

image.subject: a shabby telegraph operator in a grey coat at the door of a tower outside Paris at dusk, a gold coin pressed into his palm by a gloved hand, 1820s

storyboard.claim: The Count bribes a telegraph operator to alter two shapes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An operator taking a gold coin at a tower door at dusk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The fake signal is set in motion.
storyboard.addedInformation: Money buys the altered message.

image.subject: a crowded 1830s Paris stock exchange floor, bankers in dark frock coats shouting and waving papers under tall windows, a clerk running with a sealed note

storyboard.claim: The false news about the King of Spain reaches the Paris Bourse.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A packed exchange floor in frock coats, papers in the air.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The altered message spreads through the market.
storyboard.addedInformation: The leak hits the trading floor.

image.subject: a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar, neat side-parted hair, sallow cautious face, 1815 Marseille ship's accountant turned Paris banker, pushed through a crowded exchange floor clutching bond certificates, pale with alarm, 1830s

storyboard.claim: Danglars panics at the news.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Danglars shoves through the crowd with bond papers, pale and sweating.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Danglars reacts to the leak.
storyboard.addedInformation: He is heavily invested in Spanish bonds.

image.subject: a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar, neat side-parted hair, sallow cautious face, 1815 Marseille ship's accountant turned Paris banker, signing a sale order at a cluttered desk by candlelight, bond certificates stacked beside him, 1830s

storyboard.claim: Danglars sells his whole Spanish bond portfolio at a loss.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Danglars signing sale papers at a desk full of bond certificates.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The panic becomes a sale.
storyboard.addedInformation: The sale locks in the loss.

storyboard.claim: The telegraph message was a mistake.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only punchline on a plain frame.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The next day's news reverses the panic.
storyboard.addedInformation: The king never moved.

storyboard.claim: Danglars has locked in a multi-million franc loss.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A single large number-led frame.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The bonds rebound but his sale is final.
storyboard.addedInformation: The rebound comes too late.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, standing at a candlelit window in 1830s Paris, holding a folded letter

storyboard.claim: The Count uses an information attack again, this time on Fernand.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count at a candlelit window holding a letter.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Pivots from Danglars to Fernand.
storyboard.addedInformation: The same method is reused.

image.subject: Fernand Mondego now General Morcerf, a handsome dark-haired man in his thirties in a dark military coat with gold epaulettes, standing in a Paris salon, 1830s

storyboard.claim: Fernand is now a respected general and politician in Paris.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Fernand in a dark military coat with epaulettes in a Paris salon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the reputation the Count will attack.
storyboard.addedInformation: His standing rests on his Greek service.

storyboard.claim: Fernand's standing rests on glorious military service in Greece, so how does the Count destroy him?
storyboard.concreteVisual: A single question on a plain frame.
storyboard.onScreenText: HOW DOES THE COUNT DESTROY HIM?
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets up the Greek service the Count will expose.
storyboard.addedInformation: Greek service under Ali Pasha is the foundation.

image.subject: a young Greek woman with long dark hair in a plain pale dress and grey shawl, pale and composed, standing in a candlelit Paris hall, 1830s

storyboard.claim: The Count brings Ali Pasha's daughter Haydee to Paris.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Haydee standing composed in a Paris hall.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The Count's weapon is a living witness.
storyboard.addedInformation: She is the daughter of Ali Pasha.

image.subject: a young Greek woman in a dark cloak standing at the rostrum of the Chamber of Deputies, deputies in dark coats seated on tiered green benches, 1830s Paris

storyboard.claim: Haydee testifies before the Chamber of Deputies about Fernand.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Haydee at the rostrum facing tiered benches.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The witness takes the public stage.
storyboard.addedInformation: Her testimony proves Fernand betrayed her father.

image.subject: a small heap of gold coins spilling from a leather purse onto an open ledger beside a folded letter, candlelight, 1830s study

storyboard.claim: Fernand sold his betrayed family for gold.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Gold coins on an open ledger in candlelight.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The testimony reveals the price he was paid.
storyboard.addedInformation: The gold is the proof of betrayal.

image.subject: a Paris newspaper kiosk on a morning street, gentlemen in frock coats crowding close to read broadsheets, 1830s

storyboard.claim: Morcerf's social standing collapses in public view.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A crowd reading broadsheets at a kiosk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The testimony goes public.
storyboard.addedInformation: Paris reads the scandal.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, seated at a grand piano in a candlelit 1830s Paris salon, hands resting on the keys

storyboard.claim: The Count pulls the strings of Parisian finance and society.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count at a grand piano in a candlelit salon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Summarises the Count's control.
storyboard.addedInformation: The piano is the metaphor for his control.

storyboard.claim: Does the Count destroy his enemies or only expose a weakness already there?
storyboard.concreteVisual: A single question on a plain frame.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The host opens the structural debate.
storyboard.addedInformation: The debate frames the rest of the analysis.

storyboard.claim: He absolutely destroys them by orchestrating the hack.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A single quoted line on a plain frame.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the question directly.
storyboard.addedInformation: The Count is the active agent.

image.subject: a tall fragile house of playing cards on a polished mahogany banker's desk, a candle flame bending in a draft from an open window, 1830s Paris office

storyboard.claim: The Count is the breeze, but their houses were already cards.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A fragile card tower swaying in a draft.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the structural argument.
storyboard.addedInformation: The fragility existed before the Count.

image.subject: a stack of bond ledgers resting on a marble floor with a long crack running beneath it in a Paris bank back room, 1830s

storyboard.claim: The financial system was deeply flawed and overleveraged.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Ledgers stacked on a cracked marble floor.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Deepens the structural claim.
storyboard.addedInformation: The foundation was already breaking.

image.subject: a coil of hemp rope laid across a polished banker's desk beside an open ledger, a single candle, 1830s Paris office

storyboard.claim: The Count hands them the rope; they are overleveraged, not hacked.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A coil of rope on a banker's desk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the structural point with a metaphor.
storyboard.addedInformation: The rope is their own undoing.

image.subject: an iron-bound strongbox standing open and empty in a Paris bank back room, a candle on a bare shelf beside it, 1830s

storyboard.claim: A single false message wiping out the bank proves it was already unsound.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An empty open strongbox in a bank back room.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the cost to depositors.
storyboard.addedInformation: The bank had no reserves.

storyboard.claim: Fernand's political standing was built on a literal war crime.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement frame.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Agrees and deepens the point.
storyboard.addedInformation: The rot predates the Count.

image.subject: an open ledger with columns of names and figures on a dark desk, a quill and a red wax seal beside it, 1830s study by candlelight

storyboard.claim: The Count audited their lives and published the ledger.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An open ledger with columns on a desk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Restates the Count's method as a ledger.
storyboard.addedInformation: The published record is the weapon.

image.subject: a candle burning low beside an open ledger in a shuttered Paris office at dusk, the ledger pages marked with unpaid sums, 1830s

storyboard.claim: The enemies watch their fortunes bleed out and wait for a correction that never comes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A low candle beside an unpaid ledger in a dim office.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes the slow ruin.
storyboard.addedInformation: No market correction arrives.

image.subject: Gérard de Villefort in a black judicial coat with a white cravat, grey-streaked dark hair swept back, cold precise expression, standing alone in a dim royal courtroom corridor, Restoration France 1815

storyboard.claim: The Count uses secrets, not markets, to destroy Villefort.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Villefort alone in a dim corridor, cold and upright.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shifts from money to private secrets.
storyboard.addedInformation: The target is the prosecutor.

image.subject: a pristine white stone Paris townhouse with perfectly symmetrical shutters at dusk, a black judicial coat hanging in one lit window, 1830s

storyboard.claim: Villefort built a spotless reputation on moral illusion.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A spotless stone townhouse at dusk with one lit window.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the facade that will be exposed.
storyboard.addedInformation: The house is the architecture of his secrets.

storyboard.claim: The scene moves to a house in Auteuil, a wealthy Paris suburb.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only place card.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Scene change to the summer party.
storyboard.addedInformation: Auteuil is a wealthy suburb of Paris.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, greeting guests in evening dress at the door of a candlelit summer villa, gravel drive at dusk, 1830s

storyboard.claim: The Count hosts Paris's elite, including Villefort, at a summer dinner.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count at a villa door greeting guests in evening dress.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves the story into the Auteuil villa.
storyboard.addedInformation: Villefort is among the guests.

image.subject: an overgrown garden at dusk, guests in evening dress gathered under a tall dark plane tree, lanterns casting long shadows, 1830s

storyboard.claim: After dinner the guests enter the overgrown garden.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Guests gathered in an overgrown garden under a plane tree at dusk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The dinner leads to the garden.
storyboard.addedInformation: The tree is the key location.

image.subject: a trembling middle-aged steward in a dark livery pointing at an old plane tree in an overgrown garden at dusk, guests in evening dress standing behind him, 1830s

storyboard.claim: The steward points to the exact tree where Villefort once buried something.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A steward pointing at a plane tree with guests behind him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The garden accusation begins.
storyboard.addedInformation: He witnessed the burial years ago.

image.subject: a freshly turned patch of dark earth at the foot of a plane tree in moonlight, a spade lying beside it, 1820s night in a Paris garden

storyboard.claim: Years ago Villefort secretly buried something under the tree.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A freshly turned patch of earth under a tree in moonlight with a spade.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the buried evidence, softened to aftermath.
storyboard.addedInformation: The spade marks the night of the burial.

image.subject: Gérard de Villefort in a black judicial coat with a white cravat, grey-streaked dark hair swept back, cold precise expression, kneeling beside a dark patch of turned earth under a plane tree at night, holding a lantern, 1820s

storyboard.claim: Villefort tried to bury his illegitimate past in the garden dirt.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Villefort kneeling at turned earth by lantern light at night.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the buried secret.
storyboard.addedInformation: The secret is an affair with Madame Danglars.

storyboard.claim: He thought the earth would swallow his sin, but the Count bought the earth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement frame.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the burial into the Count's purchase.
storyboard.addedInformation: The Count owns the ground.

image.subject: heavy rain washing dark mud off a bare mound of earth under a plane tree at dusk, 1830s garden

storyboard.claim: Buried sins always wash away; the Count brings Villefort back to the spot.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Rain running off a bare mound of earth under a tree.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why burial fails.
storyboard.addedInformation: The ground gives the sin back.

image.subject: Gérard de Villefort in a black judicial coat with a white cravat, grey-streaked dark hair swept back, cold precise expression, standing on the turned earth beside a plane tree in a moonlit garden, guests watching from the path, 1830s

storyboard.claim: The Count forces Villefort to stand on the grave he dug.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Villefort standing on the turned earth while guests watch.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The public exposure of the hypocrisy.
storyboard.addedInformation: The house is now poisoned.

image.subject: a pale elegant woman in a dark silk gown in a dim velvet-draped hallway of a Paris mansion, holding a small stoppered glass vial, candlelight, 1830s

storyboard.claim: Villefort's second wife Heloise is the poison in his household.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Heloise in a dim velvet hallway holding a small glass vial.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces the second wife.
storyboard.addedInformation: She is the threat inside the house.
